title: Nonlocal Games Revisited: A Representation-Theoretic Path from Bell Locality to Quantum Pseudo-Telepathy
summary: Nonlocal games provide a unified framework for studying the distinction between classical, quantum, and more general no-signaling correlations. In this work, we develop this perspective by connecting the Bell-locality framework to several complementary mathematical representations of nonlocal games and quantum strategies. We begin with local hidden-variable models, the CHSH inequality, and the role of Bell nonlocality as a device-independent witness of entanglement, and then introduce nonlocal games through the standard predicate/verifier formalism.
